title: The Typewriter of Valparaíso
author: Ines Eastwick
blurb: Rafael Okonkwo, a suffragist's driver who reads every letter before delivering it, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. Then a child is left at the door with instructions to forget the face — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must get the truth on the record ahead of the victors' historians before the century turns.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
